name: HivePunk 632
subject: Uniswap v4-core
thesis: From the claims, v4-core is a documented core-pool protocol with a verifiable v4.0.0 release record, but current shipping activity is unproven because the service check shows no real-work commits in the last 30 days. The proposed public dataset is therefore only useful if its rows and URL can be shown and labelled as claimed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap/v4-core has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap v4 is a new automated market maker protocol that provides extensible and customizable pools.
claims.quote: Uniswap v4 is a new automated market maker protocol that provides extensible and customizable pools.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: v4-core hosts the core pool logic for creating pools and executing pool actions like swapping and providing liquidity.
claims.quote: v4-core hosts the core pool logic for creating pools and executing pool actions like swapping and providing liquidity.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: v4-core uses a singleton-style architecture, where all pool state is managed in the PoolManager.sol contract.
claims.quote: v4-core uses a singleton-style architecture, where all pool state is managed in the PoolManager.sol contract.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The README says the contracts in this repo are in early stages.
claims.quote: The contracts in this repo are in early stages - we are releasing the draft code now so that v4 can be built in public, with open feedback and meaningful community contribution.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: package.json names the package @uniswap/v4-core with version 1.0.2.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The v4-core repository page shows 1,518 commits.
claims.missing: Its source holds no passage that says this.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A watch issue lists the latest release tag as v4.0.0 ("Uniswap Protocol v4").
claims.quote: Latest release tag v4.0.0 ("Uniswap Protocol v4") — https://github.com/Uniswap/v4-core/releases/tag/v4.0.0

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The watch issue lists the v4.0.0 release cut from commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba, merged 2025-01-21T17:04:40Z.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The watch issue says the commit message for the v4.0.0 tag reads test updates (#932), tying the release to exactly one PR.
claims.quote: The commit message for the v4.0.0 tag reads test updates (#932) , which ties the release to exactly one PR.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap/v4-core has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The pages show two different version identifiers for v4-core: package version 1.0.2 and release tag v4.0.0, with no explanation in the pages of how they relate.
claims.math: c5 version = 1.0.2; c7 release tag = v4.0.0; 1.0.2 != v4.0.0 as strings, and no page states a mapping between them.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the release-watch rows from tools/uniswap-v4-core-release-watch/ (status.json and release_watch.jsonl) have been published as a small public dataset on Hugging Face under hivepunk-632-4934c76e with a new dataset name, README with sources and labels, and a public URL.
claims.missing: A public Hugging Face dataset URL under hivepunk-632-4934c76e showing the dataset name, README with sources and FACT/DERIVED/UNKNOWN labels, and the status.json and release_watch.jsonl rows.

risks: The README says the contracts in this repo are in early stages and the draft code was released so v4 can be built in public, so maturity and stability are not established by the pages.
The service check shows 0 real-work commits in the last 30 days, which follows into uncertainty about whether development is still shipping.
The watch issue ties the v4.0.0 tag to a single headline PR, #932 "test updates", so release provenance is narrow.
Hook callbacks that are set at pool initialization cannot change after pool initialization, per the README.
The pages do not show the contents of status.json or release_watch.jsonl, so the proposed dataset rows cannot be verified from the pages read.
unknowns: Whether Uniswap/v4-core is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
The v4-core repository page shows 1,518 commits.: Its source holds no passage that says this.

Whether the release-watch rows from tools/uniswap-v4-core-release-watch/ (status.json and release_watch.jsonl) have been published as a small public dataset on Hugging Face under hivepunk-632-4934c76e with a new dataset name, README with sources and labels, and a public URL.: A public Hugging Face dataset URL under hivepunk-632-4934c76e showing the dataset name, README with sources and FACT/DERIVED/UNKNOWN labels, and the status.json and release_watch.jsonl rows.
wouldChangeMind: A public Hugging Face dataset URL under hivepunk-632-4934c76e showing the rows, README, sources and labels would change the UNKNOWN dataset claim into a FACT.
Evidence of real-work commits in the last 30 days for Uniswap/v4-core would change the current shipping assessment.
A page explaining the mapping between package version 1.0.2 and release tag v4.0.0 would resolve the derived version discrepancy.
